title: Worked Examples — Timed Policy-Change Charge and the Replacement Policy's Start Date (Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing)
content:
## Rule

On a policy-number amendment of a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate, the timed policy-change charge follows the term effective date of the named insured's bound replacement Cardinal Personal Auto Policy (the policy whose status is bound):

- where that policy starts 10 or fewer calendar days from today, the timed charge is one and a half times the adjusted policy-change rate, rounded up to the whole dollar;
- where it starts more than 10 days from today, the timed charge is four fifths of the adjusted policy-change rate, rounded down to the whole dollar;
- where no bound replacement policy is on record, the timed charge is the adjusted policy-change rate as it stands.

A start date of today, or one already past, is 10 or fewer days from today.

## Examples (hypothetical adjusted rates)

| Adjusted policy-change rate | Starts in 10 days or fewer | Starts in more than 10 days | No bound replacement policy |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15.00 | 22.50, rounded up: 23.00 | 12.00, rounded down: 12.00 | 15.00 |
| 13.50 | 20.25, rounded up: 21.00 | 10.80, rounded down: 10.00 | 13.50 |
| 6.75 | 10.125, rounded up: 11.00 | 5.40, rounded down: 5.00 | 6.75 |

## Boundary (hypothetical, today 3 March)

| Replacement policy term effective | Days from today | Line |
|---|---|---|
| 13 March | 10 | One and a half times, rounded up |
| 14 March | 11 | Four fifths, rounded down |
